title: 第11章 河州城的城第12章 柳巷
content_zh:
白衣书生察觉到背后的杀意时，剑锋已至腰际。他来不及回身，身体本能地虚化。
“嗤——”
剑刃划过，带起一缕白烟。
白衣书生在三尺开外重新凝聚，低头看向腰间，笑容有些开裂：“你知不知道，后腰这个位置，对于一个男人来说，是很重要的！”
沈二眨眨眼，“不好意思。”
安衍的笛声再次响起，婉转悠扬。笛声入耳，沈二感觉自己的力量开始恢复，而且比之前更为强盛。
原来不仅能干扰敌人，还能起到辅助队友的作用。
笛声越来越急，形成一道道无形的音浪，将白衣书生笼罩。他的身形开始闪烁，忽明忽暗，像是受到了压制。
沈二抓住机会，再次提剑破空闪近，剑身横扫。白衣书生向后飘退，谁知那招横扫带出一道碧绿剑光，他躲闪不及，左臂齐肘而断，化作一团白雾散开。
他的脸色终于变了，看着短时间内无法凝聚的左臂，又看向沈二手中的剑，脸色很是复杂。
“能斩灵体的剑。”他眼睛微眯，“你小子到底是什么人？”
沈二没有回答，握紧剑柄，将剑背到身后。她此时已头昏眼花，强撑着才没让自己倒下，那现学现卖的剑招杀伤力是大，就是太费力量，配合她那个瞬间移动的术法，又累又想吐。
笛声停了，安衍收起玉笛，来到沈二身侧，“还要打吗？”他问白衣书生。
“不打了。”白衣书生摆摆手，为表诚意，他收起爪子。
“本大爷累了，今天就大发慈悲放过你们一马。不过…”他话锋一转，道：“你们还没告诉我路往哪走呢。”
安衍给了沈二一个眼神，让她安心，然后道：“正好顺路，一起吧。”
沈二瞪大双眼。
不是？就不怕半道这货把他俩都杀了。
“好啊。”白衣书生欣然答应，看向沈二，“在下涂城，不知二位道友如何称呼。”
“屠城？”沈二愣住，这名字有够混蛋的。

“哪个城？”
涂城微笑着抬手一指，“河州城的城。”
宏伟的城门牌匾上刻着河州城三个大字，沈二抬手照着字形比划，默默记下这几个字。
“河州城出去一路向东便是绍平镇。”安衍给涂城指了个方向，“此去一路都是官道，便不送了。”
“安道友怎就这么着急赶在下走？”涂城做出一副可怜模样，“相逢即是缘，怎么说也该一起吃顿饭才是。”
提到吃饭，沈二兴致勃勃，奔波数日，天天啃干粮睡石头，还要防着被人偷袭，这样的日子，她早就受够了。
“涂兄！”沈二上前，紧紧握住涂城新长出来的左手，义正言辞：“路上千万要小心保重，你我有缘自会再重逢！”
话说这么明白，涂城再赖着不走，那她可就要动手了。
涂城笑了笑，反握住她的手，“既如此，沈道友日后可要勤加练习，提升修为，下次再见面，在下可不会手下留情。”
“一定一定。”沈二学着他的样子笑道：“涂兄也要努力加油。”
两人相握的手吱吱作响。
安衍冷着脸上前把他们两个掰开，挡在沈二前面，“慢走。”
涂城抬手作揖：“不送。”
待涂城走远，沈二捧着自己通红的手吹气：“呼呼——这畜牲手劲真大。”
城内，安衍在最大的一间酒楼前停下脚步，正要进去，被沈二拦住。
“安兄。”沈二把他拉到一边，压低声音道：“这里的东西都太贵了，一道菜就够买几十个饼子，还不好吃。”
content_en:
When the scholar in white noticed the murderous intention behind him, the sword edge had already reached his waist. He didn't have time to turn around, and his body instinctively faded away.
"Tsk——"
The sword blade passed by, bringing up a wisp of white smoke.
The scholar in white regrouped three feet away, looked down at his waist, and his smile cracked: "Do you know that the position of the lower back is very important for a man!"
Shen Er blinked, "Sorry."
Anyan's flute sounded again, melodious and melodious. As the sound of the flute reached his ears, Shen Er felt that his strength began to recover, and he was stronger than before.
It turns out that it can not only interfere with enemies, but also assist teammates.
The sound of the flute became more and more urgent, forming invisible waves of sound that enveloped the scholar in white. His figure began to flicker, flickering on and off, as if he was being suppressed.
Shen Er seized the opportunity and once again raised his sword to pierce the air and dodge, his sword swept across. The scholar in white floated backwards, but unexpectedly, the sweeping move brought out a green sword light. He was unable to dodge, and his left arm was broken at the elbow, turning into a ball of white mist and scattering.
His expression finally changed. He looked at his left arm, which could not be condensed in a short period of time, and then at the sword in Shen's hand. His expression was very complicated.
"A sword that can kill spirits." He narrowed his eyes slightly, "Who are you, kid?"
Shen Er didn't answer. He clenched the hilt of the sword and put the sword behind his back. She was dizzy at this time, and she was holding on to keep herself from falling. The sword moves she learned and sold now were very lethal, but they were too labor-intensive. Combined with her teleportation technique, she felt tired and wanted to vomit.
The sound of the flute stopped. An Yan put away the jade flute and came to Shen Er's side. "Do you want to fight again?" he asked the scholar in white.
"No more fighting." The scholar in white waved his hand and put away his paws to show his sincerity.
"I'm tired, so I will be merciful and let you go today. But..." He changed the topic and said, "You haven't told me which way to go."
An Yan gave Shen Er a look to reassure her, and then said: "We're just on our way, let's come together."
Shen Er's eyes widened.
no? I'm not afraid that this guy, Ban Dao, will kill them both.
"Okay." The scholar in white agreed happily and looked at Shen Er, "In Xiatu City, I don't know what to call these two fellow Taoists."
"City Massacre?" Shen Er was stunned. This name was quite a bastard.
"Which city?"
Tu Cheng smiled and raised his hand and pointed, "The city of Hezhou City."
The magnificent city gate plaque was engraved with the three characters Hezhou City. Shen Er raised his hand to trace the characters and silently wrote down these characters.
"All the way out of Hezhou City to the east is Shaoping Town." An Yan pointed the direction to Tu Cheng, "The whole way there is official road, so I won't send it off."
"Why are you Daoist fellow An in such a hurry to leave?" Tu Cheng looked pitiful, "Meeting is fate, after all we should have a meal together."
When it came to eating, Shen Er was in high spirits. He ran around for several days, ate dry food and slept on rocks every day, and had to guard against being attacked by others. She had had enough of such days.
"Brother Tu!" Shen Er stepped forward, held Tu Cheng's newly grown left hand tightly, and spoke righteously: "Be careful and take care on the road. You and I will meet again if we are destined!"
It was so clear that if Tu Cheng didn't leave, she would take action.
Tu Cheng smiled and held her hand, "In that case, Fellow Daoist Shen must practice more diligently in the future to improve his cultivation. Next time we meet, I will not be merciful."
"Definitely." Shen Er followed his example and said with a smile: "Brother Tu, you should also work hard."
The hands between the two of them squeaked.
An Yan stepped forward with a cold face, separated the two of them, and stood in front of Shen Er, "Slow down."
Tu Cheng raised his hands and bowed: "I won't send it away."
After Tu Cheng walked away, Shen Er held his red hand and blew on it: "Huhu - this beast's hands are really strong."
In the city, Anyan stopped in front of the largest restaurant and was about to go in when he was stopped by Shen Er.
"Brother An." Shen Er pulled him aside and lowered his voice: "The things here areThey are all too expensive. One dish is enough to buy dozens of pancakes, and they are not delicious. "
